description: This header file defines the KeyGraphFeaturesInfo class within the GraphControl namespace, which encapsulates various properties related to graph features such as intercepts, extrema, asymptotes, and analysis errors. It also declares static methods for creating instances from analysis data or error types, and utility functions for converting string vectors and maps.

classes.name: KeyGraphFeaturesInfo
classes.description: A sealed ref class that holds various graph feature properties such as intercepts, extrema, asymptotes, and analysis errors, with static methods for creation and conversion utilities.
